title: ROUTINE INSPECTION 34-B
subtitle: Example portable Paranoia mission
premise: The Troubleshooters must inspect a corridor that officially does not require inspection.
publicContext: The team has received a routine RED-clearance inspection assignment. Corridor 34-B is safe, accessible, and not currently listed on any approved map.
gmGuidance: Keep the contradiction procedural. Reward confident paperwork, suspicious cooperation, and entertaining blame.

scenes.title: THE ROUTINE BRIEFING
scenes.scene: Friend Computer explains that the inspection is routine and therefore unusually urgent.
scenes.objective: Accept the assignment and determine who is responsible for the inspection clipboard.
scenes.publicContext: The assignment is active. Citizens must inspect Corridor 34-B without requesting information above RED clearance.
scenes.gmGuidance: Ask who accepts custody of the clipboard before providing directions.

cues.label: ISSUE INSPECTION ORDER
cues.note: Use after clipboard custody has been assigned.

commands.text: Troubleshooters, proceed to Corridor Thirty Four B for a routine inspection. The corridor's absence from your map confirms that no navigation problem exists.

log.title: Routine inspection assigned
log.detail: The Troubleshooters accepted responsibility for inspecting Corridor 34-B.
